name: frie
description: Brandon Frie's agent skills and hooks, as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: frie-core
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's language-neutral engineering patterns and prose style, and a hook that flags British spellings.

plugins.name: frie-dotnet
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's C#, .NET, and Blazor standards, and a hook that denies a C# or Razor edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-python
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's Python standards, and a hook that denies a Python edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-neoforge
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's NeoForge Minecraft mod conventions, layered on his Java standards.

plugins.name: secret-files-guard
plugins.description: Denies tool calls that reach a secrets file (.env, *.local.json, credential stores, private keys) through a path or a glob.
